title: Docs say GROBID auto-launch is disabled but Biblicus starts it on 0.0.0.0
description:
Found by the Cyclotron session (read-only; refs at origin/main a35694b).

`docs/cyclotron-priming.md:318-319` says the automatic Docker launch of GROBID is disabled. It is not: Biblicus auto-starts it by default (`BIBLICUS_GROBID_AUTO_START`) and publishes it on `0.0.0.0:8070`, which is LAN-reachable.

```gherkin
Feature: GROBID is loopback only
  Scenario: Biblicus auto-starts GROBID
    When the automatic launch runs
    Then port 8070 is bound to 127.0.0.1 only
```
Acceptance: fix the doc to state the real default and the env var; decide and implement 127.0.0.1 binding (or disable auto-start by default via the env Papyrus passes to Biblicus); verify with a socket check that 8070 is not reachable on the LAN address.
